name: North Hempstead Beach Park

evidence.note: Town press release: Fall Family Festival, Sat Oct 3, 12-5 PM at North Hempstead Beach Park, free, with live music.
Listing names the bands Kamellot and Dock Holiday, plus a beer and wine tent and kids' activities.
Dock Holiday's site lists the Oct 3, 4 PM festival set at 175 W. Shore Road; it bills itself as funk-country-pop-rock-n-soul.

dancing.notes: On Oct 3 the town's free Fall Family Festival has live bands outdoors. There is lots of open space near the stage, but it is a family festival, not a dance event.

description: A town beach park on Hempstead Harbor in Port Washington with a beach, boardwalk, picnic areas and big lawns. The town holds festivals and concerts here.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Bar Beach (1 W Shore Dr) is a separate park next door; not the same place. One event site wrongly calls this a Town of Hempstead festival in Roslyn; it is the Town of North Hempstead, in Port Washington.
